payload.prompt: Totalkostnadene auka monaleg frå januar til februar 2026. Analyser hovudboka og finn dei tre kostnadskontoane med størst auke i beløp. Opprett eit internt prosjekt for kvar av dei tre kontoane med kontoens namn. Opprett også ein aktivitet for kvart prosjekt.

payload.goal: Analyze the general ledger for January–February 2026, identify the three expense accounts with the largest increase in amount, then create one internal project per account (named after the account) and one activity per project.
success_checks: Ledger postings for January 2026 and February 2026 have been retrieved and compared per expense account
The three expense accounts with the largest month-over-month increase in debit amount are identified
Three internal projects are created, each named after one of the identified accounts
One activity is created and linked to each of the three projects
All three projects have status 'internal' (not billable to customer)
risk_notes: The sandbox starts empty — no ledger data exists yet; actual analysis requires real posted vouchers for Jan and Feb 2026
Expense accounts must be filtered correctly (typically account range 4000–8999 in Norwegian chart of accounts)
If no vouchers are posted for January or February 2026, the comparison will yield no results — data must be bootstrapped first
Account names may be generic (e.g. 'Lønn', 'Varekostnad') — project names should include account number for uniqueness
Activity type/category may be required by Tripletex API — default or generic activity type should be confirmed
Month boundaries must be exact: January = 2026-01-01 to 2026-01-31, February = 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28
Increase in 'amount' is ambiguous — assumed to mean net debit increase (higher cost) per account between the two months
If fewer than three expense accounts have postings in both months, the ranking may be incomplete
payload.suggested_first_action: Call GET /ledger/posting?dateFrom=2026-01-01&dateTo=2026-02-28&account=4000-8999 to retrieve all expense postings for both months, then group and compare by account.
ordered_steps: 1. GET /ledger/posting?dateFrom=2026-01-01&dateTo=2026-01-31 — fetch all postings for January 2026
2. GET /ledger/posting?dateFrom=2026-02-01&dateTo=2026-02-28 — fetch all postings for February 2026
3. Filter postings to expense accounts only (account numbers in range 4000–8999)
4. Aggregate net debit amounts per account for each month
5. Calculate delta (February amount minus January amount) per account
6. Sort accounts by delta descending and select top 3
7. For each of the 3 accounts: POST /project with body {name: '<accountNumber> <accountName>', isInternal: true, projectType: 'INTERNAL'}
8. For each created project: POST /project/activity with body {project: {id: <projectId>}, activity: {name: 'Aktivitet - <accountName>'}}
9. Verify all three projects exist via GET /project and all three activities via GET /project/activity?projectId=<id>
10. Log project IDs, activity IDs, and the account deltas for audit/documentation

planned_endpoints.summary: Create customer. Related customer addresses may also be created.
Find employees corresponding with sent data.
Find projects corresponding with sent data.

rules: When email is provided, ALWAYS set BOTH email AND invoiceEmail to the same value.
Do NOT send isCustomer (it's readOnly and auto-set).
For addresses, use postalAddress={addressLine1, postalCode, city, country={id: 161}} for Norway.
ALWAYS search first: GET /employee?email=<email> — the sandbox often has pre-existing employees. Reuse if found.
Only POST /employee if GET returns 0 results.
When POSTing, ALWAYS include department={"id": dept_id}. Create department first if needed.
userType should be 'STANDARD' unless admin is explicitly requested.
Requires customer={"id": customer_id} and projectManager={"id": employee_id}.
startDate is REQUIRED — use today_iso from execution_brief if prompt doesn't specify a date.
If the prompt mentions a project number (prosjektnummer), set number=<project_number>.
isInternal should be false unless explicitly stated as internal project.
If description text is provided, set description=<text>.
For fixed-price projects, set isFixedPrice=true and fixedPrice=<amount> (camelCase).
Requires project={"id": project_id} and activity={"id": activity_id}.
If activity already linked (409), ignore the error and proceed.
If a default hourly rate already exists (409 Duplicate entry), GET /project/hourlyRates?projectId=... then PUT to update it.

payload.headline: Correct API execution but wrong top-3 expense accounts identified from ledger data
what_went_wrong: Checks 1, 3, 4 failed — the agent's identified top-3 accounts (7100, 6500, 5000) appear incorrect; the actual top-3 likely differ, suggesting errors in aggregating or filtering ledger postings.
Pagination may have been incomplete or amounts misread from trimmed API responses — the agent noted '15 out of 21 postings' but may have missed or double-counted entries.
The agent may have incorrectly handled negative amounts or credit postings when summing expense account totals, leading to wrong delta calculations.
Account range filtering (4000-8999) may have excluded or included wrong accounts, or the agent misidentified which accounts are cost accounts in this specific chart of accounts.
what_worked: Zero 4xx errors across all 15 API calls — clean execution with no failed requests.
Project and activity creation logic was correct: 3 projects created as internal, 3 activities linked via /project/projectActivity.
what_to_try_next: Carefully re-aggregate all paginated ledger postings ensuring ALL pages are fetched and amounts are summed correctly, paying attention to debit vs credit sign conventions.
Use /ledger/account to get the full chart of accounts and verify which account numbers are classified as expense/cost accounts before filtering postings.
Print/log intermediate aggregation results explicitly before selecting top-3 to catch arithmetic errors in delta calculations between months.
unnecessary_calls: Duplicate GET /ledger/posting calls (3 calls for January alone) — consolidate into single paginated fetch with correct fields parameter.
Two search_tripletex_api calls at start returned empty results and added no value — skip these and go directly to inspect_tripletex_endpoint.
